from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ShareCapitalRecord(BaseModel):
    """A share capital observation from a single filing."""
    fiscal_year: int | None = Field(description="The fiscal year this data represents")
    shares_outstanding: int | None = Field(description="Number of common shares outstanding at period end")
    is_split_adjusted: bool | None = Field(description="True if this share count reflects post-2023 reverse stock split adjustment")
    split_ratio: str | None = Field(description="Reverse stock split ratio if applicable, e.g., '1-for-300'")
    is_pre_split_unadjusted: bool | None = Field(description="True if this is unadjusted pre-split share count")
    entity_name: str | None = Field(description="Company name as it appears in this filing")
    snapshot_date: str | None = Field(description="Specific date if data is as of a particular date rather than year-end")
    filing_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of document, e.g., '10-K'")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the share count")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    share_capital_records: list[ShareCapitalRecord]
